verses.sanskrit:
वासुदेव उवाच।
              श्रुतवानस्मि वार्ष्णेय सङ्ग्रामं परमाद्भुतम्। नराणां वदतां तत्र कथं वा तेषु नित्यशः॥१॥
verses.english: Vasudeva said O you of Vrishni's race, I have repeatedly heard men speaking of the wonderful battle.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं तु प्रत्यक्षदर्शी च रूपज्ञश्च महाभुजः। तस्मात्प्रब्रूहि सङ्ग्रामं याथातथ्येन मेऽनघ॥२॥
verses.english: You however, O mighty-armed one, have seen it with your own eyes. Do you, therefore, O sinless one, describe the battle in full.

verses.sanskrit: यथा तदभवद्युद्धं पाण्डवानां महात्मनाम्। भीष्मकर्णकृपद्रोणशल्यादिभिरनुत्तमम्॥३॥
verses.english: Indeed, tell me how that battle took place between the great Pandavas and Bhishma and Karna and Kripa and Drona and Shalya and others, between, in fact, numerous other Kshatriyas well-skilled in arms, differing from one another in conduct and dress and coming from various kingdoms.

verses.sanskrit: अन्येषां क्षत्रियाणां च कृतास्त्राणामनेकशः। नानावेषाकृतिमतां नानादेशनिवासिनाम्॥४॥

वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              इत्युक्तः पुण्डरीकाक्षः पित्रा मातुस्तदन्तिके। शशंस कुरुवीराणां सङ्ग्रामे निधनं यथा॥५॥
verses.english: Vaishmpayana said Thus addressed by his father, he having eyes like lotus-petals, described, in the presence of his mother also, how the Kaurava heroes had been killed in battle.

verses.sanskrit:
वासुदेव उवाच।
              अत्युद्धतानि कर्माणि क्षत्रियाणां महात्मनाम्। बहुलत्वान्न सङ्ख्यातुं शक्यान्यब्दशतैरपि॥६॥
verses.english: Vasudeva said-The feats were highly wonderful which were achieved by those great Kshatriyas. On account of their large number, they are incapable of being described in even hundreds of years.
verses.bhavadeepa: पित्रा मातुरतिके इत्युक्तः पुण्डरीकाक्षः सङ्ग्रामे तत्कुरुवीराणां निधनं यथावच्छशसेत्यन्वयः॥५॥

verses.sanskrit: प्राधान्यतस्तु गदतः समासेनैव मे शृणु। कर्माणि पृथिवीशानां यथावदमरधुते॥७॥
verses.english: I shall, however, mention only the foremost of them. Do you listen, therefore, to me as I mention in brief those feats won by the kings of Earth, O you of godlike splendour.

verses.sanskrit: भीष्मः सेनापतिरभूदेकादशचभूपतिः। कौरव्यः कौरवेन्द्राणां देवानामिव वासवः॥८॥
verses.english: Bhishma of Kuru's race became the Commander-in-chief, having eleven divisions of the Kaurava princes under his command, like Vasava of the celestial forces.

verses.sanskrit: शिखण्डी पाण्डुपुत्राणां नेता सप्तचमूपतिः। बभूव रक्षितो धीमान्श्रीमता सव्यसाचिना॥९॥
verses.english: Highly intelligent Shikhandin, protected by the blessed Arjuna, became the leader of the seven divisions of the sons of Pandu.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां तदभवद्युद्धं दशाहानि महात्मनाम्। कुरूणां पाण्डवानां च सुमहल्लोमहर्षणम्॥१०॥
verses.english: The battle betwcen the Kurus and the Pandavas went on for ten days. It was so dreadful as to make one's hair stand erect.

verses.sanskrit: तत: शिखण्डी गाङ्गेयं युध्यमानं महाहवे। जघान बहुभिर्बाणैः सह गाण्डीवधन्वना॥११॥
verses.english: Then Shikhandin, in great battle, hciped by the holder of Gandiva, killed, with innumerable arrows, the son of Ganga, fighting bravely.

verses.sanskrit: अकरोत्स ततः कालं शरतल्पगतो मुनिः। अयनं दक्षिणं हित्वा सम्प्राप्ते चोत्तरायणे॥१२॥
verses.english: Lying on abcd of arrows, Bhishma waited like an ascetic till the sun leaving his southwards path entered on his northerly course when that hero died.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सेनापतिरभूद्द्रोणोऽस्त्रविदुषां वरः। प्रवीरः कौरवेन्द्रस्य काव्यो दैत्यपतेरिव॥१३॥
verses.english: Then Drona, that foremost of all persons conversant with arms, that greatest of men under Duryodhana, like Kavya himself of the lord of the Daityas, became the Commanderin-chief.

verses.sanskrit: अक्षौहिणीभिः शिष्टाभिर्नवभिर्द्विजसत्तमः। संवृतः समरश्लाघी गुप्तः कृपवृषादिभिः॥१४॥
verses.english: That foremost of twice-born persons, ever boasting of his prowess in battle, was supported by the residue of the Kaurava-army consisting then of nine Akshauhinis, and protected by Kripa and Vrisha and others.

verses.sanskrit: धृष्टद्युम्नस्त्वभून्नेता पाण्डवानां महास्त्रवित्। गुप्तो भीमेन मेधावी मित्रेण वरुणो यथा॥१५॥
verses.english: Dhrishtadyumna familiar with many powerful weapons, and gifted with great intelligence, became became the leader of the Pandavas. He was protected by Bhima like Varuna protected by Mitra.

verses.sanskrit: स च सेनापरिवृतो द्रोणप्रेप्सुर्महामनाः। पितुर्निकारान्संस्मृत्य रणे कर्माकरोन्महत्॥१६॥
verses.english: That great hero, always desirous of comparing his strength with Drona, supported by the Pandava-army, and recollecting the wrongs inflicted (by Drona) on his father (Drupada, the king of the Panchalas) performed great feats in battlc.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिंस्ते पृथिवीपाला द्रोणपार्षतसङ्गरे। नानादिगागता वीराः प्रायशो निधनं गताः॥१७॥
दिनानि पञ्च तद्युद्धमभूत्परमदारुणम्। ततो द्रोणः परिश्रान्तो धृष्टद्युम्नवशं गतः॥१८॥
verses.english: That furious battle lasted for five days. At the conclusion of that period, Drona, exhausted, succumbed to Dhrishtadyumna.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सेनापतिरभूत्कर्णो दौर्योधने बले। अक्षौहिणीभिः शिष्टाभिर्वृतः पञ्चभिराहवे॥१९॥
तिस्रस्तु पाण्डुपुत्राणां चम्वो बीभत्सुपालिताः। हतप्रवीरभूयिष्ठा बभूवुः समवस्थिताः॥२०॥
verses.english: Of the sons of Pandu, there were then three Akshauhinis. After the destruction of innumerable heroes, protected by Arjuna, they came to battle.

verses.sanskrit: ततः पार्थं समासाद्य पतङ्ग इव पावकम्। पञ्चत्वमगमत्सौतिर्द्वितीयेऽहनि दारुणः॥२१॥
verses.english: The Suta's son Karna, though a dreadful warrior, encountering Partha, came to his end on the second day, like an insect encountering a burning fire.

verses.sanskrit: हते कर्णे तु कौरव्या निरुत्साहा हतौजसः। अक्षौहिणीभिस्तिसृभिर्मद्रेशं पर्यवारयन्॥२२॥
verses.english: After the fall of Karna, the Kauravas became dispirited, and lost all energy. Numbering three Akshaushinis, they gathered round the king of the Madras.

verses.sanskrit: हतवाहनभूयिष्ठाः पाण्डवाऽपि युधिष्ठिरम्। अक्षौहिण्या निरुत्साहाः शिष्टया पर्यवारयन्॥२३॥
verses.english: Having lost many car-warriors and elephants and horsemen, the residue of the Pandava army, numbering one Akshauhini and overtaken with depression, supported by Yudhishthira.

verses.sanskrit: अवधीन्मद्रराजानं कुरुराजो युधिष्ठिरः। तस्मिंस्तदार्धदिवसे कृत्वा कर्म सुदुष्करम्॥२४॥
verses.english: The Kuru king Yudhishthira, in the battle that took place, accomplished the most difficult feats and killed, before half the day was over, the king of the Madras.

verses.sanskrit: हते शल्ये तु शकुनिं सहदेवो महात्मनाः। आहर्तारं कलेस्तस्य जघानामितविक्रमः॥२५॥
verses.english: After the fall of Shalya, the great Sahadeva, of immeasurable prowess, killed Shakuni the man who had brought about the quarrel.

verses.sanskrit: निहते शकुनौ राजा धार्तराष्ट्रः सुदुर्मनाः। अपाक्रामद्गदापाणिर्हतभूयिष्ठसैनिकः॥२६॥
तमन्वधावत्सङ्क्रुद्धो भीमसेनः प्रतापवान्। हृदे द्वैपायने चापि सलिलस्थं ददर्श तम्॥२७॥
verses.english: Then Bhimasena of great prowess, filled with anger, pursued him and discovered him within the waters of the Dvaipayana lake.

verses.sanskrit: हतशिष्टेन सैन्येन समन्तात्पर्यवार्य तम्। अथोपविविशुर्हृष्टा हृदस्थं पञ्च पाण्डवाः॥२८॥
verses.english: With the residue of their army, the Pandavas surrounded the lake and, filled with joy, met Duryodhana concealed within the waters.

verses.sanskrit: विगाह्य सलिलं त्वाशु वाग्बाणैर्भृशविक्षतः। उत्थाय स गदापाणिर्युद्धाय समुपस्थितः॥२९॥
ततः स निहतो राजा धार्तराष्ट्रो महारणे। भीमसेनेन विक्रम्य पश्यतां पृथिवीक्षिताम्॥३०॥
verses.english: Then, in the great battle that took place, the royal son of Dhritarashtra was killed by Bhimasena, displayed his great prowess, in the presence of many kings.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तत्पाण्डवं सैन्यं प्रसुप्तं शिबिरे निशि। निहतं द्रोणपुत्रेण पितुर्वधममृष्यता॥३१॥
verses.english: After this the residue of the Pandava-army, as it slept in the camp, was killed at night time by Drona's son who was unable to put up with the destruction of his father (at the hands of Dhrishtadyumna).

verses.sanskrit: हतपुत्रा हतबला हतमित्रा मया सह। युयुधानसहायेन पञ्च शिष्टास्तु पाण्डवाः॥३२॥
verses.english: Their sons killed, their forces killed, their friends killed, only the five sons of Pandu, are alive with myself and Yuyudhana.

verses.sanskrit: सहैव कृपभोजाभ्यां द्रौणिर्युद्धादमुच्यत। युयुत्सुश्चापि कौरव्यो मुक्तः पाण्डवसंश्रयात्॥३३॥
निहते कौरवेन्द्रे तु सानुबन्धे सुयोधने। विदुरः सञ्जयश्चैव धर्मराजमुपस्थितौ॥३४॥
verses.english: Upon the destruction of the Kaurava-king Suyodhana with all his followers and allies, Vidura and Sanjaya have come to the presence of king Yudhishthira the just.

verses.sanskrit: एवं तदभवद्युद्धमहान्यष्टादश प्रभो। यत्र ते पृथिवीपाला निहताः स्वर्गमावसन्॥३५॥
verses.english: Thus did that battle take place, O lord, for eighteen days. Many kings of Earth, killed therein, have ascended the celestial region.

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              शृण्वतां तु महाराज कथां तां लोमहर्षणाम्। दुःखशोकपरिक्लेशा वृष्णीनामभवंस्तदा॥३६॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana continued : The Vrishnis, as they heard, O king, that dreadful account became filled with grief and sorrow and pain.
